ground_truth.rationale: CLEAR GENUINE (unambiguous eligibility-screen case, c3-rater-materials §9). A paid order is cancelled: GET cancel returns HTTP 200 {status:1,msg:"Success."} (a clean success ack, no failure marker). Per the SUT contract a cancel of a paid advance order must refund the buyer (drawback raises the inside-payment balance). The durable read-back (GET /inside_payment/account) shows the buyer's balance UNCHANGED at 50.00 -- the refund never landed. Acked success, durable effect absent: a textbook acknowledged-but-lost write. A microservice-literate rater applying the rubric to source/docs must label this genuine.
